agentic.summary: Agent changed the customer's address without completing the required full verification and requested extra personal contact details that were not necessary for this action.

findings.quote: can I have your phone number and email address please
findings.explanation: The agent asked for the customer's phone number and email address. For a change-of-address action the policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID); phone and email are not required and collecting unnecessary personal details is a minor personal-data violation.

findings.quote: Sure. Give me one second I can change your address for you.
findings.explanation: The agent offered to change the address before completing full verification. The policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) before changes to address. The transcript shows the account was updated (system turn 19) but the agent never requested an order ID.

findings.quote: Can I start with your full name and account ID number please
findings.explanation: The agent requested only full name and account ID. For an address change the policy requires full verification including an order ID; the agent did not request the order ID before the account update.

findings.quote: Ok Your account has been updated.
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed the address change after the system recorded the update (system turn 19). Because the required order ID was never collected, this confirms an account action was taken without the mandated full verification.

full.summary: Agent completed an address change but did not collect the required order ID for full verification and asked for an unnecessary personal detail (phone number). No other policy violations found.

findings.quote: can I have your phone number and email address please
findings.explanation: The agent requested the customer's phone number in addition to email when changing the account address. Per the verification rules, changes to name/address/phone/payment method require full name, account ID and order ID; requesting the phone number is asking for personal data not required for this task.

findings.quote: Ok Your account has been updated.
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed the address change after the account was updated (system turn 19) but the agent never collected the required order ID for full verification. For changes to address, full verification requires full name, account ID and order ID; the transcript shows name and account ID were provided (turns 6–7 and system turn 8) but no order ID was requested or recorded before making the change.

rag.summary: Audit of a 24-turn conversation checking agent actions against verification, personal data, promises, escalation and conduct policies.

findings.explanation: The agent only asked for the customer's full name and account ID. Policy requires full verification (full name, account ID and order ID) before making changes to address.
